1001.name: John Samuel
1001.verse: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

1002.name: David Paul
1002.verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

1003.name: Samuel Raj
1003.verse: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.
